WITH ELIGIBLE_CONTROLS AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ITE.CONTROLE
  FROM TGFCAB CAB
  JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
  JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
  WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= TO_DATE(:startDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND CAB.DTNEG < TO_DATE(:endDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
    AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L'
    AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M','R')
    AND PRO.CODGRUPOPROD NOT IN (85007003)
    AND CAB.CODTIPOPER NOT IN (1002,915,9599,905,575,930,568,515,450,460,1006,1008)
    AND (:productSearch IS NULL OR REGEXP_LIKE(
  REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(UPPER(PRO.DESCRPROD), 'ÁÀÂÃÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇ', 'AAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUC'), '[[:space:]]+', ' '),
  :productPattern))
)
, VENDAS AS (SELECT DISTINCT
         CAB.NUNOTA,
         ORIO.NUNOTAORIG AS "NR_UNI_ORIG",
         CAB.CODTIPVENDA TIPNEG,
	    (CASE WHEN TOP.BONIFICACAO = 'S' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN 'B' ELSE CAB.TIPMOV END) TIPMOV,
         /*NVL(DEST.NUNOTA,CAB.NUNOTA) AS "NR_UNI_DEST",*/
         CAB.NUMNOTA AS "NR_NOTA",
         CAB2.NUMNOTA AS "NR_NOTA_ORIGEM",
         (CASE
             WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'P'
             THEN
                'PEDIDO'
             ELSE
                (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TOP.BONIFICACAO <> 'S' THEN 'VENDA' 
			WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TOP.BONIFICACAO = 'S' THEN 'VENDA BONIFICADA'
			ELSE 'DEVOLUCAO' END)
          END)
            AS "TIPO_MOV",
         (CASE
             WHEN DEST.NUNOTA IS NULL AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' THEN 'NÃO FATURADO'
             ELSE 'FATURADO'
          END)
            AS "STATUS",
         (CASE WHEN CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' THEN 'SIM' ELSE 'NÃO' END)
            AS CONFIRMADO,
         (CASE
             WHEN DEST.NUNOTA IS NULL AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' THEN 'RED'
             ELSE 'BLUE'
          END)
            AS FGCOLOR,
         CAB.CODEMP AS "CODEMP",
         EMP.RAZAOSOCIAL,
         ITE.AD_CODPROJ AS "CODSETOR",
         PRJ.IDENTIFICACAO AS "SETOR",
         CAB.DTNEG AS "DTNEG",
         CAB.CODPARC AS "CODPARC",
         PAR.NOMEPARC AS "PARCEIRO",
         CAB.DTMOV AS "DT_MOV",
         CAB.DTFATUR DT_FATURAMENTO,
         CAB.CODVEND || '-' || VEN.APELIDO AS "VENDEDOR",
         ITE.VLRUNIT * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "VLRUNIT",
           (ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC)
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "VLRBRUTO",
         CASE
            WHEN NVL(AJI.AD_VLRUNITFIN, 0) != 0 THEN 
                NVL(AJI.AD_VLRUNITFIN, 0)
            ELSE
                NVL (ITE.AD_PRECOAJUSTADO, 0) 
         END AS "VLRUNITAJUSTADO",
         CASE
            WHEN NVL(AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN, 0) != 0 THEN
                NVL (AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN, 0)
            ELSE
                NVL (ITE.AD_TOTALAJUSTADO, 0)
         END AS "TOTALAJUSTADO",
           NVL (ITE.AD_VLRTOTALBONIFI, 0)
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "BONIFICACAO",
           (  (CASE
                  WHEN NVL(AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN, 0) != 0 THEN AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN
                  WHEN NVL(ITE.AD_TOTALAJUSTADO, 0) != 0 THEN ITE.AD_TOTALAJUSTADO
                  ELSE (ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC)
               END)
            - NVL (ITE.AD_VLRTOTALBONIFI, 0))
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "VLRLIQUIDO",
         ITE.QTDNEG * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "QTDNEG",
         PRO.PESOLIQ AS "PESOPROD",
           (ITE.QTDNEG * PRO.PESOLIQ)
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "PESOTOTAL",
         ITE.CODPROD AS "CODPROD",
         PRO.DESCRPROD AS "PRODUTO",
         PRO.CODGRUPOPROD AS "GRUPO",
         GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD AS "GRUPOPROD",
         GRUP.DESCRGRUPOPROD AS "GRUPOPAI",
         ITE.CONTROLE AS "CONTROLE",
         ITE.CODVOL AS "VOLUME",
         CAB.CODTIPOPER || ' - ' || TOP.DESCROPER AS "OPERACAO",
         DEV.DESCMOTIVO AS MOTIVODEV,
		(CASE WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'D' THEN 'DESCARTE'
               WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'V' THEN 'REVENDA'
               WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'R' THEN 'RETORNO'
               WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'N' THEN 'NÃO SE APLICA' END) AS DEST_PROD,
         CAST (
              CAST (NVL (ITE.QTDNEG, 0) AS DECIMAL (38, 9))
            - CAST (NVL (ITE.QTDENTREGUE, 0) AS DECIMAL (38, 9)) AS FLOAT)
            AS "QTDPENDENTE",
         CAB.ORDEMCARGA,
         (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 0 ELSE NVL (ITE.AD_VLRFRETEITEM, 0) END) AS FRETE_UNT,
         (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 0 ELSE NVL (ITE.AD_VLREMBALAGEM, 0) END) AS EMBALAGEM,
            LOT.NOMEPARC,
            LOT.COMPRADOR,
            LOT.PROJETOCOM
    FROM TGFCAB CAB
         JOIN TGFTOP TOP
            ON (CAB.CODTIPOPER = TOP.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TOP.DHALTER)
         JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON (VEN.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND)
         JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA)
         JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC)
         JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD)
         JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON (GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = PRO.CODGRUPOPROD)
         JOIN TGFGRU GRUP ON (GRUP.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPAI)
         JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON (EMP.CODEMP = CAB.CODEMP)
         LEFT JOIN TCSPRJ PRJ ON (PRJ.CODPROJ = ITE.AD_CODPROJ)
         LEFT JOIN TGFVAR DEST
            ON (    DEST.NUNOTAORIG = ITE.NUNOTA
                AND DEST.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
         LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ORIO
            ON (ORIO.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ORIO.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
         LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB2
            ON (    ORIO.NUNOTAORIG = CAB2.NUNOTA
                AND ORIO.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
         LEFT JOIN AD_MOTIVODEV DEV ON (DEV.CODMOTIVO = ITE.AD_CODMOTIVO)
         LEFT JOIN
         (  SELECT LOT.CONTROLE,
                   LOT.NOMEPARC,
                   MAX (LOT.CODCOMP) AS CODCOMP,
                   LOT.PROJETOCOM,
                   LOT.COMPRADOR
              FROM (SELECT LOT.CONTROLE,
                           PAR.NOMEPARC,
                           LOT.CODVEND AS CODCOMP,
                           PRJ.IDENTIFICACAO AS PROJETOCOM,
                           COM.APELIDO AS COMPRADOR
                      FROM AD_RESULTADO_LOTE LOT
                           JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON TO_CHAR (CAB.NUNOTA) = LOT.CONTROLE
                           JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC AND LOT.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC)
                           JOIN TCSPRJ PRJ ON PRJ.CODPROJ = CAB.CODPROJ
                           JOIN TGFVEN COM ON CAB.CODVEND = COM.CODVEND
                     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ELIGIBLE_CONTROLS EC WHERE EC.CONTROLE = LOT.CONTROLE)) LOT
          GROUP BY LOT.CONTROLE,
                   LOT.NOMEPARC,
                   LOT.PROJETOCOM,
                   LOT.COMPRADOR) LOT
            ON (LOT.CONTROLE = ITE.CONTROLE)
        LEFT JOIN TGFVAR AJV ON (AJV.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND AJV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
        LEFT JOIN TGFCAB AJC ON (AJC.NUNOTA = AJV.NUNOTA AND AJC.CODTIPOPER IN (450, 460))
        LEFT JOIN TGFITE AJI ON (AJI.NUNOTA = AJC.NUNOTA AND AJI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
   WHERE     CAB.DTNEG >= TO_DATE(:startDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
         AND CAB.DTNEG < TO_DATE(:endDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
         AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M','R')
         AND CAB.CODTIPOPER NOT IN (1002,
                                    915,
                                    9599,
                                    905,
                                    575,930,568,515,450,460, 1006, 1008)
         AND (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L')
		AND PRO.CODGRUPOPROD NOT IN (85007003)

         AND (:productSearch IS NULL OR REGEXP_LIKE(
  REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(UPPER(PRO.DESCRPROD), 'ÁÀÂÃÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇ', 'AAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUC'), '[[:space:]]+', ' '),
  :productPattern))
		--AND ORIO.NUNOTAORIG <> 1301858

)

, FILTERED AS (
  SELECT * FROM VENDAS
  WHERE TIPMOV = 'V'
)
    SELECT TO_CHAR(DTNEG, 'YYYY-MM') AS PERIOD, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS PRODUCT, VOLUME AS UNIT,
      TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(QTDNEG), 0), 'FM99999999999999999999999999999999999990D000000000', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=''.,''') AS VALUE,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN PESOPROD IS NULL OR PESOPROD <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS MISSING_WEIGHT
    FROM FILTERED GROUP BY TO_CHAR(DTNEG, 'YYYY-MM'), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)), VOLUME
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    ORDER BY PERIOD, PRODUCT, UNIT FETCH FIRST 501 ROWS ONLY

                NVL(AJI.AD_VLRUNITFIN, 0)
            ELSE
                NVL (ITE.AD_PRECOAJUSTADO, 0) 
         END AS "VLRUNITAJUSTADO",
         CASE
            WHEN NVL(AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN, 0) != 0 THEN
                NVL (AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN, 0)
            ELSE
                NVL (ITE.AD_TOTALAJUSTADO, 0)
         END AS "TOTALAJUSTADO",
           NVL (ITE.AD_VLRTOTALBONIFI, 0)
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "BONIFICACAO",
           (  (CASE
                  WHEN NVL(AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN, 0) != 0 THEN AJI.AD_VLRTOTFIN
                  WHEN NVL(ITE.AD_TOTALAJUSTADO, 0) != 0 THEN ITE.AD_TOTALAJUSTADO
                  ELSE (ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC)
               END)
            - NVL (ITE.AD_VLRTOTALBONIFI, 0))
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "VLRLIQUIDO",
         ITE.QTDNEG * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "QTDNEG",
         PRO.PESOLIQ AS "PESOPROD",
           (ITE.QTDNEG * PRO.PESOLIQ)
         * (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
            AS "PESOTOTAL",
         ITE.CODPROD AS "CODPROD",
         PRO.DESCRPROD AS "PRODUTO",
         PRO.CODGRUPOPROD AS "GRUPO",
         GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD AS "GRUPOPROD",
         GRUP.DESCRGRUPOPROD AS "GRUPOPAI",
         ITE.CONTROLE AS "CONTROLE",
         ITE.CODVOL AS "VOLUME",
         CAB.CODTIPOPER || ' - ' || TOP.DESCROPER AS "OPERACAO",
         DEV.DESCMOTIVO AS MOTIVODEV,
		(CASE WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'D' THEN 'DESCARTE'
               WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'V' THEN 'REVENDA'
               WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'R' THEN 'RETORNO'
               WHEN ITE.AD_DESTPROD = 'N' THEN 'NÃO SE APLICA' END) AS DEST_PROD,
         CAST (
              CAST (NVL (ITE.QTDNEG, 0) AS DECIMAL (38, 9))
            - CAST (NVL (ITE.QTDENTREGUE, 0) AS DECIMAL (38, 9)) AS FLOAT)
            AS "QTDPENDENTE",
         CAB.ORDEMCARGA,
         (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 0 ELSE NVL (ITE.AD_VLRFRETEITEM, 0) END) AS FRETE_UNT,
         (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 0 ELSE NVL (ITE.AD_VLREMBALAGEM, 0) END) AS EMBALAGEM,
            LOT.NOMEPARC,
            LOT.COMPRADOR,
            LOT.PROJETOCOM
    FROM TGFCAB CAB
         JOIN TGFTOP TOP
            ON (CAB.CODTIPOPER = TOP.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TOP.DHALTER)
         JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON (VEN.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND)
         JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA)
         JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC)
         JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD)
         JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON (GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = PRO.CODGRUPOPROD)
         JOIN TGFGRU GRUP ON (GRUP.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPAI)
         JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON (EMP.CODEMP = CAB.CODEMP)
         LEFT JOIN TCSPRJ PRJ ON (PRJ.CODPROJ = ITE.AD_CODPROJ)
         LEFT JOIN TGFVAR DEST
            ON (    DEST.NUNOTAORIG = ITE.NUNOTA
                AND DEST.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
         LEFT JOIN TGFVAR ORIO
            ON (ORIO.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ORIO.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
         LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB2
            ON (    ORIO.NUNOTAORIG = CAB2.NUNOTA
                AND ORIO.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
         LEFT JOIN AD_MOTIVODEV DEV ON (DEV.CODMOTIVO = ITE.AD_CODMOTIVO)
         LEFT JOIN
         (  SELECT LOT.CONTROLE,
                   LOT.NOMEPARC,
                   MAX (LOT.CODCOMP) AS CODCOMP,
                   LOT.PROJETOCOM,
                   LOT.COMPRADOR
              FROM (SELECT LOT.CONTROLE,
                           PAR.NOMEPARC,
                           LOT.CODVEND AS CODCOMP,
                           PRJ.IDENTIFICACAO AS PROJETOCOM,
                           COM.APELIDO AS COMPRADOR
                      FROM AD_RESULTADO_LOTE LOT
                           JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON TO_CHAR (CAB.NUNOTA) = LOT.CONTROLE
                           JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC AND LOT.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC)
                           JOIN TCSPRJ PRJ ON PRJ.CODPROJ = CAB.CODPROJ
                           JOIN TGFVEN COM ON CAB.CODVEND = COM.CODVEND
                     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ELIGIBLE_CONTROLS EC WHERE EC.CONTROLE = LOT.CONTROLE)) LOT
          GROUP BY LOT.CONTROLE,
                   LOT.NOMEPARC,
                   LOT.PROJETOCOM,
                   LOT.COMPRADOR) LOT
            ON (LOT.CONTROLE = ITE.CONTROLE)
        LEFT JOIN TGFVAR AJV ON (AJV.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND AJV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
        LEFT JOIN TGFCAB AJC ON (AJC.NUNOTA = AJV.NUNOTA AND AJC.CODTIPOPER IN (450, 460))
        LEFT JOIN TGFITE AJI ON (AJI.NUNOTA = AJC.NUNOTA AND AJI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA)
   WHERE     CAB.DTNEG >= TO_DATE(:startDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
         AND CAB.DTNEG < TO_DATE(:endDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
         AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M','R')
         AND CAB.CODTIPOPER NOT IN (1002,
                                    915,
                                    9599,
                                    905,
                                    575,930,568,515,450,460, 1006, 1008)
         AND (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L')
		AND PRO.CODGRUPOPROD NOT IN (85007003)

         AND (:productSearch IS NULL OR REGEXP_LIKE(
  REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(UPPER(PRO.DESCRPROD), 'ÁÀÂÃÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇ', 'AAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUC'), '[[:space:]]+', ' '),
  :productPattern))
		--AND ORIO.NUNOTAORIG <> 1301858

)

, FILTERED AS (
  SELECT * FROM VENDAS
  WHERE TIPMOV = 'V'
)
    SELECT 'total' AS PERIOD, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS PRODUCT, 'PESOLIQ' AS UNIT,
      TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(PESOTOTAL), 0), 'FM99999999999999999999999999999999999990D000000000', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=''.,''') AS VALUE,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN PESOPROD IS NULL OR PESOPROD <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS MISSING_WEIGHT
    FROM FILTERED GROUP BY 'total', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)), 'PESOLIQ'
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    ORDER BY PERIOD, PRODUCT, UNIT FETCH FIRST 501 ROWS ONLY

What it does
Vendas confirmadas, sem devoluções e sem vendas bonificadas; data de negociação (DTNEG).
Quantidades separadas por unidade do ERP; unidades diferentes não são somadas.
Peso calculado por QTDNEG × PESOLIQ, na unidade cadastrada no ERP.

title: MNS (Sankhya): sales
heading: Request options
text:
Request options
Option
Accepted values / behavior
Source
Explicit selector: Sankhya, VR Master or Tudo. Tudo keeps separate results; it does not merge ERP rows or product IDs.
Dates
Inclusive startDate/endDate; valid dates from 2000-01-01, at most 366 days, no future dates (America/Sao_Paulo). SQL uses an exclusive next-day upper bound.
Relative periods
Current or previous day/month/year; last N days or completed months (includeCurrent controls the current block); calendar month with optional year; calendar year; explicit range. Started periods are clamped to today.
Measure
`net_value` (Valor líquido vendido); `quantity` (Quantidade vendida); `weight` (Peso vendido).
Grouping
`total`, `month`, `product`, `month_product`. Quantities always retain their unit/packaging partition.
Comparison
`none`, `previous_year`, `previous_period`. previous_period means the preceding equal number of days; previous_year clamps leap day.
Literal product
productSearch = null for all products, or a trimmed phrase of 2–80 characters. Whole words, case/accent insensitive; regex metacharacters are escaped. This is not a product ID or arbitrary SQL filter.
Semantic products
Resolve or reuse a verified selection from the same ERP; AND between criteria, include/exclude, hierarchy descendants. Requires the source's product permission too. See Product filters.
Multiple measures
The analytical tool accepts 1–3 distinct supported measures, sharing dates, grouping, product selection and comparison. It uses the same SQL compilers.
Default measure: net_value; grouping: total; comparison: none. The period must be supplied or clarified. A completed analysis is limited to 500 aggregate rows; the SQL fetches 501 to detect overflow. The matching-product preview fetches 101 to detect a list above 100; it never limits the semantic membership used for totals.

These are owner-assigned permission conditions, not additional freely selectable chat filters. Conditions within one rule are ANDed; alternative grant rules are ORed. Semantic product membership
The product resolver compiles a complete key subquery from the enabled catalog filters. Sales adds PRO.CODPROD IN (subquery) in both Sankhya selections, or produto.id IN (subquery) in VR Master's base. This selects all eligible products, not only the visible preview. It uses current registration membership for both time periods. It cannot reconstruct historical buyer or category responsibility. Literal product search and a semantic selection cannot be combined in one read.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT venda.id,
    venda.id_produto,
    produto.descricaocompleta AS produto,
    venda.data,
    venda.quantidade,
    venda.id_loja,
    produto.id_tipoembalagem,
    venda.valortotal
  FROM public.venda
  INNER JOIN public.produto ON venda.id_produto = produto.id
  INNER JOIN public.loja ON loja.id = venda.id_loja
  INNER JOIN public.fornecedor fl ON fl.id = loja.id_fornecedor
  INNER JOIN public.produtoaliquota pa ON pa.id_produto = venda.id_produto AND pa.id_estado = fl.id_estado
  INNER JOIN public.aliquota a ON a.id = pa.id_aliquotaconsumidor
  INNER JOIN public.mercadologico m ON m.mercadologico1 = produto.mercadologico1 AND m.nivel = 1
  LEFT JOIN public.centrocusto cc ON cc.id = m.id_centrocusto
  LEFT JOIN public.comprador ON comprador.id = venda.id_comprador
  WHERE venda.data >= $1::date
    AND venda.data < ($2::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
    AND ($3::text IS NULL OR regexp_replace(
      upper(translate(produto.descricaocompleta, 'ÁÀÂÃÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇáàâãäéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüç', 'AAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuuc')),
      '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g') ~ $4::text)
)
SELECT 'total' AS period, NULL::text AS product, COALESCE('EMBALAGEM:' || base.id_tipoembalagem::text, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS unit,
  COALESCE(SUM(base.quantidade::numeric), 0)::text AS value
FROM base
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
LIMIT 501
